blocks.orig: Sangaiwe Tented Lodge is located at one of the most beautiful spots of the Tarangire region, nestled against a hill overlooking the amazing Tarangire savannah. It’s one of our longtime favorites, with 18 double and 2 family tents on elevated wooden platforms, and two family cottages. All rooms are warmly decorated with plush beds, ensuite bathrooms, and a private terrace to enjoy the view. The food is good, the pool is refreshing and if you are lucky, you can spot elephants and other animals while hanging out near your tent or the pool. Just be aware – since most animals prefer a stroll in the early hours of the day, the early bird really does catch the worm here. A lovely excuse for an early start to your safari day!
blocks.html: Sangaiwe Tented Lodge occupies one of the loveliest spots in the Tarangire region, tucked against a hill with views over the wonderful Tarangire savannah. It has long been one of our favourites, with 18 double and 2 family tents on raised wooden platforms, as well as two family cottages. Every room is warmly furnished with comfortable beds, an en-suite bathroom and a private terrace for taking in the view. The food is good, the pool is refreshing and, with some luck, you may see elephants and other animals while relaxing by your tent or the pool. Do bear in mind that most animals like to wander in the early hours of the day, so here the early bird truly catches the worm. A good reason to start your safari day early!
